grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK Sign In credentials and photo ID
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and protect your personal tax information

grants.description: Access your National Insurance contribution and credits record from HMRC
grants.purpose: To show you your complete National Insurance record and identify any gaps

grants.description: Access your State Pension forecast from DWP to show impact of voluntary contributions
grants.purpose: To show you how filling gaps would affect your State Pension entitlement

grants.description: Process payment for voluntary National Insurance contributions
grants.purpose: To process your voluntary contribution payment securely

grants.description: Store your contact details for correspondence about your NI record
grants.purpose: To send you confirmation and receipts for any payments, and future correspondence about your record

revocation.mechanism: Revoke through your Personal Tax Account settings or by contacting HMRC
revocation.effect: You will no longer be able to view your NI record online. Any voluntary contribution payments in progress will be cancelled.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot make payments on your behalf. Agent cannot change your NI record or submit corrections. Agent cannot make decisions about whether you should pay voluntary contributions - this requires your explicit instruction. For complex cases near State Pension age, agent must recommend human specialist consultation.
